race.comment: MADAME PETITE (12) missed the kick and raced greenly on debut and then improved sharply to finish runner-up at Warrnambool 11 days ago. She again draws the pole and can go one better. CIRQUE (2) makes her debut as a 4YO with plenty of jump-out experience behind her. A good draw helps, and any market confidence will be worth following in. RAVENS GLOW (8) probably should have won a race by now and made up a lot of late ground for second when resuming at Wangaratta just over 3 weeks ago. She cops a tricky gate here but can pick up a win at short notice. CHARLOTTE'S WEB (1) will be peaking third up from a spell and will find this easier than her first couple of starts this season. Each way.
